score_umbrella_length: score a pandas DataFrame from the umbrella_length experiment grouped by chain_length
score_by_group_custom: score a DataFrame grouped by an arbitrary column using the regret threshold method
plot_learning_curves: plot average regret through time for the umbrella_length experiment grouped by chain_length
plot_scaling_analysis: plot average return at end of learning to investigate scaling across chain lengths
plot_individual_seeds: plot individual run returns through time colored by chain_length for the umbrella experiment
